# Docs team message templates

Message templates used by the Docs team during the release cycle. The
[release timeline](../release-timeline.md) links to each template at the point
where it is used. Replace every `<placeholder>` before sending.

| Template | When |
|----------|------|
| [Shadow confirmation and welcome](shadow-onboarding.md) | Week 1, after shadow selection |
| [Localization discussion](localization-discussion.md) | Week 1, GitHub discussion in k/sig-release |
| [Weekly assignments](weekly-assignments.md) | Every week, Docs team Slack group |
| [Deadline announcement](deadline-announcement.md) | Before each docs deadline |
| [Placeholder PR request](placeholder-pr-request.md) | After Enhancements Freeze, on each tracked KEP |
| [Docs Freeze status](docs-freeze-status.md) | After Code Freeze, on each tracked KEP |
| [Review reminders](review-reminders.md) | Between the placeholder PR deadline and Docs Freeze |
| [After Docs Freeze](after-docs-freeze.md) | After Docs Freeze, on KEPs without merged docs |
| [SIG leads release notes review](../sig-leads-email.md) | Around Code Freeze and for the final release notes draft |
| [Final release notes review](final-release-notes-review.md) | After the final release notes PR is open |
| [SIG Docs release day support](sig-docs-release-day-support.md) | About two weeks before release day |
| [kubeadm documentation check](kubeadm-docs-check.md) | About two weeks before release day |
| [Localization release update](localization-release-update.md) | Release week |
